acs.AC-001.1: WHEN a Project Manager uploads a file with the  extension that is valid UTF-8, at most 10 MB, has every required column and at least one data row, for a Project they manage, THE system SHALL create an Import Preview and return its counts and the first page of its rows.
acs.AC-001.2: IF the uploaded file name does not end in  (case-insensitive), THEN THE system SHALL reject it with MSG27 and create no preview.
acs.AC-001.3: IF the uploaded file is not valid UTF-8 or cannot be parsed as RFC 4180 CSV, THEN THE system SHALL reject it with MSG27 and create no preview.
acs.AC-001.4: IF the uploaded file is larger than 10 MB, THEN THE system SHALL reject it with MSG28 and create no preview.
acs.AC-001.5: IF the header row lacks any of , THEN THE system SHALL reject the file with MSG29 listing every missing column and create no preview.
acs.AC-001.6: IF the file has a header row but no data rows, THEN THE system SHALL reject it with MSG04 and create no preview.
acs.AC-001.7: WHEN the file starts with a UTF-8 byte-order mark, THE system SHALL ignore the mark when it reads the header.
acs.AC-001.8: WHEN the header contains columns that are not in the template, THE system SHALL ignore those columns.
acs.AC-001.9: IF the selected Project is not managed by the caller or is not Active, THEN THE system SHALL reject the upload with HTTP 403 and create no preview.
acs.AC-001.10: IF the caller does not have the Project Manager role, THEN THE system SHALL reject the upload with HTTP 403.
acs.AC-001.11: WHEN a Project Manager uploads a file while they already have an unconfirmed preview, THE system SHALL delete the previous preview and keep only the new one.
acs.AC-001.12: WHEN a field value is enclosed in double quotes, THE system SHALL read commas, doubled quotes and line breaks inside it as part of the value.
acs.AC-002.1: WHEN the preview is created, THE system SHALL mark a row Valid when every rule in AC-002.2 to AC-002.7 passes, and Error otherwise, listing every failed rule of that row.
acs.AC-002.2: IF a row has an empty , , , ,  or  (blank after trimming), THEN THE system SHALL mark the row Error with MSG01 for each empty field.
acs.AC-002.3: IF a row has  over 50,  over 200,  over 10,000 or  over 100 characters, THEN THE system SHALL mark the row Error with MSG02 for each field over its limit.
acs.AC-002.4: IF the five Solution sections of a row together exceed 10,000 characters, THEN THE system SHALL mark the row Error with MSG02 for the Solution.
acs.AC-002.5: IF a row's  already exists as a Ticket, THEN THE system SHALL mark the row Error with MSG31.
acs.AC-002.6: IF the same  appears in more than one row of the file, THEN THE system SHALL mark every one of those rows Error with MSG78.
acs.AC-002.7: IF a row has a non-empty  that is not an ISO date () or is after today in Vietnam time (Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh), THEN THE system SHALL mark the row Error with MSG39.
acs.AC-002.8: THE system SHALL list the preview rows page by page (page size at most 100, ordered by row number), giving for each row its row number in the file, Ticket ID, Title, Author, Resolved date, the first 200 characters of each Solution section, its result (Valid / Error / Removed) and its error details.
acs.AC-002.9: WHEN at least one row is Error, THE system SHALL return MSG30 with the number of Error rows.
acs.AC-002.10: THE system SHALL compare Ticket IDs exactly as written, after trimming surrounding spaces.
acs.AC-002.11: WHEN the Project Manager lists the rows with a result filter (Valid, Error or Removed), THE system SHALL return only the rows with that result.
acs.AC-003.1: WHEN the Project Manager removes rows from their preview, THE system SHALL mark those rows Removed, whether they were Valid or Error, and exclude them from Confirm.
acs.AC-003.2: IF the preview belongs to another user, has been confirmed, or no longer exists, or the requested row number does not exist in it, THEN THE system SHALL reject the read or change with HTTP 404 and change nothing.
acs.AC-003.3: WHEN the Project Manager opens one row of their preview, THE system SHALL return its full content, including every Solution section, read-only.
acs.AC-003.4: IF the caller no longer manages the preview's Project or the Project is no longer Active, THEN THE system SHALL reject listing rows, opening a row and removing rows with HTTP 403 (MSG08) and change nothing.
acs.AC-004.1: WHEN the Project Manager confirms a preview with at least one Valid, non-removed row, THE system SHALL save each such row as a Ticket of the preview's Project with source CSV, status Published, writer = the  value (none when absent), its description, resolved date and Solution sections, with surrounding spaces trimmed from every value.
acs.AC-004.2: WHEN Tickets are saved on Confirm, THE system SHALL record, for each Ticket, an approve decision by the confirming Project Manager (GBR-23).
acs.AC-004.3: WHEN Confirm succeeds, THE system SHALL record one Import Batch with the Project, the Project Manager, source CSV, the file name, the number of tickets published, the number of Error and Removed rows, status Completed and the date, and link each new Ticket to it.
acs.AC-004.4: WHEN Confirm succeeds, THE system SHALL return MSG32 with the created count and the skipped count (Error + Removed rows) and delete the preview.
acs.AC-004.5: IF the preview has no Valid, non-removed row, THEN THE system SHALL reject Confirm with HTTP 409 and import nothing.
acs.AC-004.6: IF the preview's Project is no longer Active at Confirm, THEN THE system SHALL reject Confirm with MSG40, import nothing and record no Import Batch.
acs.AC-004.7: IF a Valid row's  has become an existing Ticket since the preview was created, THEN THE system SHALL fail the whole Confirm with MSG33, import nothing, and record one Import Batch with status Failed.
acs.AC-004.8: IF saving any Ticket fails, THEN THE system SHALL import no Ticket, return MSG33, and still record one Import Batch with status Failed, 0 published, and an error description that contains no row content.
acs.AC-004.9: IF the preview belongs to another user or no longer exists, THEN THE system SHALL reject Confirm with HTTP 404.
acs.AC-004.10: WHEN Confirm succeeds, THE system SHALL publish a "tickets published" event with the new Ticket ids after the transaction commits.
acs.AC-004.11: IF the preview's Project is Active but the caller no longer manages it, THEN THE system SHALL reject Confirm with HTTP 403 (MSG08), import nothing and record no Import Batch. (The MSG40 check of AC-004.6 comes first.)
acs.AC-004.12: IF the same preview is confirmed again while or after a Confirm of it succeeds, THEN THE system SHALL reject the second Confirm with HTTP 404, record no Import Batch for it, and leave the first import unchanged.
acs.AC-005.1: WHEN a Project Manager downloads the template, THE system SHALL return a UTF-8 CSV file whose header row is  and no data rows.
acs.AC-005.2: IF the caller does not have the Project Manager role, THEN THE system SHALL reject the download with HTTP 403.
acs.AC-006.1: WHEN the daily cleanup job runs, THE system SHALL delete every unconfirmed preview created more than 24 hours earlier, with its rows.
acs.AC-006.2: WHILE a preview is younger than 24 hours, THE system SHALL keep it.
acs.AC-006.3: IF deleting one preview fails, THEN THE system SHALL log the error and continue deleting the other expired previews.
